stem.text: A steel ball is falling at constant speed in oil.
Which graph shows the variation with time of the gravitational potential energy $E_\text{p}$ and the kinetic energy $E_\text{k}$ of the ball?

A.alt: Graph of energy against time with a horizontal line labelled Ek and a curve labelled Ep that starts high on the energy axis and falls to the right.

B.alt: Graph of energy against time with a horizontal line labelled Ek and a straight line labelled Ep that starts high on the energy axis and falls to the right.

C.alt: Graph of energy against time with a curve labelled Ek that starts low on the energy axis and rises to the right, and a curve labelled Ep that starts high on the energy axis and falls to the right.

D.alt: Graph of energy against time with a straight line labelled Ek that starts at the origin and rises to the right, and a straight line labelled Ep that starts high on the energy axis and falls to the right.
